en.headline: FEHD issues orders after rats spotted inside Hung Hom ParknShop
en.dek: A social media video showed rodents feeding on produce and snacks inside the closed supermarket; the department found signs of rodent activity and required corrective action.
body: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department has issued statutory orders after a video circulated online showing rats inside a ParknShop supermarket in Hung Hom.

The footage, posted in mid-July, appeared to show rodents moving freely among vegetables and packaged snacks inside the closed store at Ka Wai Estate after midnight. Following a surprise inspection, the department said it found holes in walls and signs of rodent activity and issued a statutory order requiring the operator to take corrective measures within a set deadline.

ParknShop said it had immediately disposed of affected food, carried out thorough cleaning and disinfection with a professional pest-control company, and would strengthen pest-control measures and increase inspections. The department said it would conduct follow-up checks and had also issued orders to nearby building management.

zh.headline: 紅磡百佳發現老鼠 食環署發出法定通知
zh.dek: 社交媒體影片顯示老鼠在已關閉的超市內覓食蔬菜及零食，食環署巡查後發現鼠患跡象並要求限期糾正。
body: 食物環境衛生署就紅磡一間百佳超級市場發現老鼠一事發出法定通知。
一段於七月中流傳的影片顯示，午夜過後有老鼠在家維邨該店已關閉的店舖內自由活動，並在蔬菜及包裝零食附近覓食。食環署進行突擊巡查後表示，發現牆身有洞及鼠患跡象，已向營辦商發出法定通知，要求在限期內採取糾正措施。
百佳表示已即時棄置受影響食物，並聯同專業滅蟲公司進行徹底清潔及消毒，同時會加強滅蟲措施及增加巡查。食環署表示會跟進巡查，亦已向附近物業管理發出通知。
